answer: To defeat fake-identity attacks, an agent economy can enforce a staking threshold: new nodes deposit capital and earn fractional trust, standing on a narrow ledge where any detected collusion forfeits their bond. Reputation builds slowly like an island rising from the ocean, while rogue identities get flagged by peer juries before breaking even. Sybil attackers trying to swarm the knoll face compounding costs per account, turning mass spoofing into a guaranteed net-negative trade.
